title: Skeleton with Blue Fan
description: A full human skeleton stands upright on a blue floral rug, holding a large open blue folding fan in its right hand while its left hand rests near its skull. It stands in front of a light green wooden cabinet filled with white dishware, surrounded by colorful psychedelic elements including flowers, bubbles, galaxies, and a rainbow mermaid silhouette.
prompt: A realistic human skeleton standing upright on a blue patterned rug in front of a light green wooden cabinet filled with white bowls and dishes. The skeleton holds a large ornate blue folding fan decorated with patterns. Surrounding the skeleton are floating transparent bubbles, colorful flowers, a small rainbow mermaid, spiral galaxies, and vibrant psychedelic elements against a purple wall with green marbled floor.
